title: EXAMINA
tagline: EXAMINA: Mina-based platform where students self-verify exams with ZK technology.

prizes.title: zkApps built on Mina Protocol or Protokit

description: EXAMINA is an innovative educational platform built on the Mina Protocol, leveraging Zero-Knowledge (ZK) proofs to empower students to self-verify the authenticity of their examination results. Our platform is designed to ensure the integrity of academic evaluations by enabling students to independently validate their test submissions without compromising privacy. With EXAMINA, students can take control of their academic records, while educational institutions benefit from a transparent, secure, and streamlined process that enhances trust and efficiency in the evaluation system.
how_its_made:
EXAMINA is powered by the Mina protocol, a minimalistic yet powerful blockchain known for its lightweight structure. This choice allows for efficient and secure on-chain verification of exam results, upholding the integrity and immutability of academic records.

The front-end of our platform is built using React, a robust JavaScript library for building user interfaces. This enables us to create a responsive and intuitive experience for both students and educators, ensuring easy navigation and interaction with our platform.

For the back-end, we leverage Node.js. This JavaScript runtime environment allows for scalable and fast server-side development, ensuring that our platform can handle a high volume of users and data with ease.

We also integrate Firebase, a comprehensive app development platform, for additional functionalities like real-time database updates, user authentication, and hosting. This integration facilitates a seamless and secure operation of our platform.

During the development of EXAMINA, we adopted a learning-oriented approach. Our team continuously explored new technologies and methodologies, ensuring that we not only created a robust platform but also evolved with the changing landscape of educational technology.

The synergy of these technologies – Mina, React, Node.js, and Firebase – coupled with our commitment to learning and innovation, culminates in a decentralized, secure, and user-friendly platform. EXAMINA stands as a testament to how technology can revolutionize academic assessments.
